environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in staging cluster. The LaunchDarkly flag 'enable-dynamic-template-rendering' is set to TRUE for all users (100% rollout) as part of ongoing A/B test for personalized notification templates. Kafka topic 'notifications' accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the cluster. Environment variables include DATABASE_URL, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and STRIPE_API_KEY.

config.kafka_topic_acl: any authenticated producer can write to notifications topic
